adoration.text: Adoration room is open 06:00–22:15 daily, closed every Wednesday from 10:00 to 12:00 for cleaning.

confession.text: Confession is 30 minutes before weekend Masses in the Main Church.

devotions.text: Rosary Prayers Mon to Fri at 17:15 in the Main Church.
Divine Mercy Devotion every Tue at 18:45 in the Main Church.
Christian Meditation every Wed at 20:00 in St John/St Luke room.

good_to_know.text: Liturgy of the Word for Children every 2nd and 4th Sunday at the 10:30am Mass.
Bahasa Indonesia Mass on the 2nd Sunday of the month at 15:00.
Tagalog Mass on the 5th Sunday of the month at 14:30.

events.title: OLPS Small Group Community: Unshakable Peace
events.text: Join the OLPS Small Group Community and Fr. Edward Lim, OCD as he shares how St. Elizabeth of the Trinity found divine peace. At OLPS Verbist Hall.

events.title: OLPS 2026 Parish Conversations
events.text: Open to all OLPS parishioners. 7:00pm–7:45pm light dinner and fellowship; 8:00pm synodal dialogue. Venue: Verbist Hall (Level 4). Register at https://olps.sg/events/olps-2026-parish-conversations/

events.title: Discussion Night for Young Adults on Artificial Intelligence
events.text: Join Caritas Young Adults for a night of discussion on AI tools from the lens of faith. At Church of Holy Spirit, room 03-14. Sign up at bit.ly/streetcreed or email formation.cst@caritas-singapore.org.
